versions.changelog: Expanded the map across its full surrounding region, reworked visitor attractions from operator and national visitor statistics, and fixed duplicated visitor counts and understated hospital demand.
Refreshed every Czech map so duplicated town and village names are now labeled distinctly by district, each at its own location.
Refreshed every Czech map with per-building foundation depth and cleaner water rendering, and reclassified catch-all buildings like warehouses, factories, and schools.

Buildings render in true 3D at heights measured from national airborne-LiDAR (ČÚZK) — factories, warehouses, and industrial halls stand at their real height instead of a flat single-storey default — with footprints and workplace placement from the RÚIAN state cadastre. Worker totals and rural coverage come from the CZSO 2021 census employment measure with sub-settlement commute O/D, and a gravity-based correction brings the COVID-inflated 2021 self-commute back to plausible pre-pandemic levels. Special-demand coverage spans hospitals, universities, airports, museums, theatres, libraries, spa/wellness, and sports & convention venues.
